title: Taiwan Votes in Local Elections and a Nuclear Power Referendum
summaryZh: 九合一選舉投票日 同場公投是否重啟核能
summaryHi: ताइवान में स्थानीय चुनाव और परमाणु ऊर्जा पर जनमत संग्रह के लिए मतदान हुआ।
summaryEs: Taiwán vota en sus elecciones locales y en un referéndum sobre la energía nuclear.
summaryJa: 台湾で統一地方選の投票、原発政策を問う住民投票も同時実施。
summaryKo: 대만 지방선거 투표일, 원전 정책 국민투표도 함께 실시.
summaryEn: Taiwan held its '9-in-1' local elections on Saturday, along with a referendum on returning to nuclear power.
paragraphs: Taiwan held its "9-in-1" local elections on Saturday, with polls opening at 8 am and closing at 4 pm. According to the Central Election Commission, about 19.58 million people were eligible to vote, roughly 600,000 of them for the first time, at more than 18,000 polling stations.

Over 11,000 posts were up for grabs. Voters chose mayors in Taiwan's six special municipalities and leaders in 16 other cities and counties, along with 919 city and county councillors, township chiefs and nearly 7,800 borough chiefs.

The most closely watched race was in Taipei, where Kuomintang (KMT) Mayor Chiang Wan-an sought re-election against Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) legislator Puma Shen. In Kaohsiung, a long-time DPP stronghold, the DPP's Lai Jui-lung faced the KMT's Ko Chih-en in the contest to succeed Chen Chi-mai.

Alongside the elections, about 20 million people could vote in a referendum on whether to abandon the "nuclear-free homeland" policy. It is the fourth vote on nuclear power since 2018. To pass, "yes" votes must outnumber "no" votes and equal at least a quarter of all eligible voters.

Voters were told to keep their phones switched off, as photographing ballots can bring fines of up to NT$300,000. Election results were expected on Saturday evening, with the referendum count possibly later.
Today is election day in Taiwan. Polls opened at 8 in the morning and close at 4 in the afternoon. About 19.6 million people can vote.
People are choosing many local leaders. People vote for mayors or county leaders in 22 cities and counties. Voters also choose city council members and village chiefs.
In Taipei, Mayor Chiang Wan-an wants to win again. His rival is Puma Shen. In Kaohsiung, two new people want to be mayor.
There is also one big question for all voters. Should Taiwan use nuclear power again? People can vote yes or no.
Voters must bring their ID card. They must turn off their phones. Taking photos of the ballot is not allowed. The results will come on Saturday night.

大約有1,960萬人可以投票。
人們要選出許多地方領袖。
22個縣市的選民要選出縣市首長。
選民也要選市議員和村里長。
在台北，市長蔣萬安希望再次當選。
他的對手是沈伯洋。
在高雄，有兩位新人想當市長。
所有選民還要回答一個大問題。
台灣應該再次使用核能嗎？
人們可以投同意或不同意。
選民必須帶身分證。
他們必須把手機關機。
不可以拍攝選票。
結果將在星期六晚上出爐。

paragraphs: Voters across Taiwan went to the polls on Saturday for the local elections, often called the "9-in-1" elections. Polling stations opened at 8 am and were due to close at 4 pm. About 19.58 million people were able to vote, including around 600,000 first-time voters.

More than 11,000 positions were on the ballot. These included mayors in six large special municipalities and magistrates or mayors in 16 other cities and counties, as well as hundreds of council seats and thousands of neighbourhood chiefs.

In Taipei, Mayor Chiang Wan-an of the Kuomintang was hoping to win a second term against Puma Shen of the Democratic Progressive Party. In Kaohsiung, Lai Jui-lung and Ko Chih-en were the main candidates to replace Mayor Chen Chi-mai.

Voters also answered a referendum question: should Taiwan give up its "nuclear-free homeland" policy? For the proposal to pass, "yes" votes must beat "no" votes and reach at least a quarter of all eligible voters.
Officials reminded people to bring their ID and to switch off their phones. Taking photos inside polling stations can lead to a large fine. Results were expected on Saturday evening.

約有1,958萬人可以投票，其中包括約60萬名首投族。
共有超過1萬1千個職位要改選。
其中包括六個直轄市市長、其他16個縣市的縣市長，以及數百個議員席次和數千名里長。
在台北，國民黨籍市長蔣萬安希望擊敗民進黨的沈伯洋，爭取連任。
在高雄，賴瑞隆和柯志恩是接替市長陳其邁的主要候選人。
選民也要回答一道公投題目：台灣是否應放棄「非核家園」政策？
公投提案要通過，同意票必須多於不同意票，且至少達到全體有投票權人的四分之一。
官員提醒民眾攜帶身分證並將手機關機。
在投票所內拍照可能被處以高額罰款。
選舉結果預計在星期六晚上揭曉。

sentZh: 台灣星期六舉行「九合一」地方選舉，投票所上午8點開放、下午4點關閉。
根據中選會，約1,958萬人具投票資格，其中約60萬人是首次投票，投票所超過1萬8千個。
共有超過1萬1千個職位待爭取。
選民選出六都市長、其他16個縣市的首長，以及919名縣市議員、鄉鎮市長和近7,800名里長。
最受矚目的選戰在台北，國民黨籍市長蔣萬安尋求連任，對手是民進黨立委沈伯洋。
在長期為民進黨大本營的高雄，民進黨的賴瑞隆與國民黨的柯志恩角逐接替陳其邁。
除了選舉，約2,000萬人還可就是否放棄「非核家園」政策進行公投。
這是2018年以來第四次核能公投。

paragraphs: Polls opened across Taiwan at 8 am on Saturday for the "9-in-1" local elections, a contest widely seen as a mid-term test for President Lai Ching-te's Democratic Progressive Party (DPP). The Central Election Commission said roughly 19.58 million citizens were eligible to cast ballots, about 600,000 of them for the first time.

The sheer scale of the exercise is striking: more than 11,000 offices across 8,906 electoral districts, staffed by over 300,000 election workers at 18,244 polling stations. At the top of the ticket were the mayors of six special municipalities and the heads of 16 other cities and counties.

Attention centred on Taipei, where the Kuomintang's (KMT) Chiang Wan-an was defending his seat against DPP legislator Puma Shen, and on Kaohsiung, a DPP heartland in which Lai Jui-lung and the KMT's Ko Chih-en were vying to succeed the term-limited Chen Chi-mai. In 2022, the KMT captured 14 of the 22 top posts.

Voters were simultaneously asked whether Taiwan should abandon its "nuclear-free homeland" policy, the fourth nuclear referendum since 2018. Passage requires a simple majority of valid votes as well as affirmative votes from at least a quarter of all eligible referendum voters.
Mayoral results were expected by Saturday evening, although the referendum tally could take longer.
sentZh: 星期六上午8點，台灣各地投票所開放，進行「九合一」地方選舉，這場選戰被普遍視為賴清德總統所屬民進黨的期中考。
中選會表示，約1,958萬名公民具投票資格，其中約60萬人是首次投票。
這場選舉的規模之大令人驚嘆：8,906個選區中有超過1萬1千個公職，由逾30萬名選務人員在18,244個投票所執行。
選票上最重要的是六個直轄市市長，以及其他16個縣市的首長。
焦點集中在台北，國民黨的蔣萬安力守市長寶座，對手是民進黨立委沈伯洋；另一焦點是民進黨大本營高雄，賴瑞隆與國民黨的柯志恩角逐接替任期屆滿的陳其邁。
2022年，國民黨拿下22席首長中的14席。
選民同時被問及台灣是否應放棄「非核家園」政策，這是2018年以來第四次核能公投。
通過門檻除了有效票簡單多數，有效同意票還須達全體公投有投票權人數的四分之一。
市長選舉結果預計星期六晚上出爐，但公投計票可能需要更長時間。

paragraphs: Taiwanese voters went to the polls on Saturday in the "9-in-1" local elections, a nationwide contest that is widely interpreted as a referendum on the governing Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) midway through President Lai Ching-te's term. Some 19.58 million people were eligible to participate, including approximately 600,000 first-time voters.

The logistical undertaking was considerable. More than 11,000 offices, ranging from municipal mayors to borough chiefs, were contested across 8,906 districts, with over 300,000 officials deployed to 18,244 polling stations between 8 am and 4 pm.

The most consequential races were arguably those in Taipei and Kaohsiung. In the capital, Kuomintang (KMT) incumbent Chiang Wan-an sought a second term against DPP legislator Puma Shen, while in Kaohsiung, traditionally a DPP stronghold, Lai Jui-lung and the KMT's Ko Chih-en competed to replace the outgoing Chen Chi-mai. The KMT, which secured 14 of the 22 mayoral and magistrate posts in 2022, hoped to consolidate its position.

In parallel, the electorate was asked to decide whether Taiwan should abandon its "nuclear-free homeland" policy. For the proposal to be adopted, affirmative votes must not only exceed negative ones but also represent at least a quarter of all eligible voters, a threshold that previous referendums have struggled to meet.

Authorities warned that photographing ballots was prohibited and punishable by substantial fines. Mayoral outcomes were anticipated on Saturday evening, with the referendum result possibly following later.
sentZh: 台灣選民星期六前往投票，參加「九合一」地方選舉，這場全國性選戰普遍被解讀為對賴清德總統任期過半之際執政民進黨的信任投票。
約1,958萬人具投票資格，其中包括約60萬名首投族。
這次的後勤工作相當龐大。
從直轄市市長到里長，共有超過1萬1千個公職在8,906個選區競逐，逾30萬名選務人員於上午8點至下午4點間派駐18,244個投票所。
影響最深遠的選戰可說是台北與高雄。
在首都，國民黨籍現任市長蔣萬安尋求連任，對手是民進黨立委沈伯洋；而在傳統上是民進黨大本營的高雄，賴瑞隆與國民黨的柯志恩競逐接替即將卸任的陳其邁。
國民黨在2022年拿下22席縣市長中的14席，希望鞏固其地位。
同時，選民也被要求決定台灣是否應放棄「非核家園」政策。
提案要通過，同意票不僅須多於不同意票，還必須至少達到全體有投票權人的四分之一，而過去的公投往往難以跨過這個門檻。
當局警告，拍攝選票是被禁止的，可處以高額罰款。
市長選舉結果預計在星期六晚上出爐，公投結果可能稍後才公布。
